verdict.rationale: Zamzar documents a REST API (send a request to the `jobs` endpoint with API-key auth) and an official Java SDK advertised to "convert files in one line of code" that can wait for a job, download the result and delete the source files. That is scriptable automation built into the product, but there is no documented standalone CLI command. Missing for 10: an official one-line CLI command, explicit shell or CI usage examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of scripted use.
